about: Faclon components, read from the Figma file Design MCP (pages: components, Badges) on 2026-10-16. Every value is a token name; resolve it with get_tokens (css_vars maps each one to its CSS custom property). Text uses text roles, so sizes follow the output format.

source.method: Variable bindings on each component (not the description text)

usage: Components are building blocks, not templates: combine them into any layout the content needs, inside the format's guardrails.

The named cards (Card, Icon Card, Highlight Card, List Item Card, Metric Card, Banner Card, Media Card, FAQ Card, Profile Card) are starting points, not the full set. When none fits the content, design a new card: start from Card base and pick a tone (it brings the fill, border, radius and padding), then lay out its slot freely with the atoms, controls and text roles, spaced with spacing tokens. A new card never adds a surface style, colour, radius, shadow or font the system does not define.

Give each section the card design its content needs (for example a number-led, image-led, split, stat-row, step or comparison card) rather than the same card in every section. Cards in one row or grid are one set and share a design.
Keep each component's tokens as bound: fill, border, radius, padding, gap and text role. Never restyle one with a value the system does not define.
Themes come from the colour mode: the dark version of a component is the same component with Semantic Colors in Dark mode. Never pick dark colours by hand.
Text inside components uses text roles, so sizes follow the output format (Document, Newsletter, Deck) and breakpoint.
Cards fill their grid column; how many sit in a row comes from the format (for example at most 3 in an A4 document).
Chips, badges, buttons, tags and contact pills hug their content on a single line, with equal padding left and right; they never stretch or wrap. If a label is too long for the space, tell the user.
Content must fit its component: never let text overflow a card, chip, badge or button, and never shrink it below the format's minimum size. If it does not fit, tell the user and offer options.
Components are static: no hover, pressed or open states.
Image is a placeholder: replace it with the real image, or leave a placeholder for the designers. Icons come from Lucide, only when asked.

components.name: Heading content
components.use: The heading block inside cards: optional eyebrow, a title and optional sub-text.

components.name: Body Text
components.use: A paragraph. Fills the width of its card.

components.name: Divider
components.use: Hairline separator that stretches to its container's width.

components.name: Image
components.use: Placeholder for an image, icon, chart, logo or avatar. Resize freely and replace with the real image; icons come from Lucide, only when asked.

components.name: Chip
components.use: Small square-cornered label inside cards: tags, trend or status next to a metric. Neutral is the default tone.

components.name: Accordion Item
components.use: One FAQ row: the question, a chevron, an optional answer and a divider underneath (turn the divider off on the last row). Static: no open or close interaction.

parts.note: Shown when the asset needs answers; the answer text comes from the user.

components.name: Stat tile
components.use: One big number with a short label, for a single headline figure (e.g. factories live, assets connected). Default tone on the page; Brand or Inverse to make one figure stand out. Optional trend chip. In a row of figures, use the same tone and size for each.

components.name: Logo wall
components.use: A grid of client or partner logos at one even size, as proof ("Trusted by"). Each slot takes a real logo file from the asset library, unchanged; 4 or 6 across, as many rows as needed; optional eyebrow caption.

components.name: Feature grid
components.use: Three or four features side by side on the page: icon, feature name and one or two lines. No card surface; use Icon Card when each feature needs its own card. Each feature gets a Lucide icon that names it, coloured with a text token.

components.name: Process flow
components.use: Numbered steps left to right joined by a connector, each with a step name and one line: for a sequence or a method (e.g. connect, decide, optimise). 3, 4 or 5 steps.

components.name: Comparison table
components.use: A side-by-side comparison: a criterion column and two compared columns (without and with Faclon Labs, build and buy, before and after), the Faclon Labs column highlighted. Rows and headers come from the user.

components.name: CTA band
components.use: A full-width strip with one message and one button: the single next step at the end of a section, page, newsletter or deck. Brand, Inverse or Default tone; one button only.

components.name: Cover block
components.use: The opening of an A4 document or a deck cover: eyebrow (document type), the full Faclon Labs logo top-right, title in Heading/H1, subtitle and a meta line. Light, Dark or Brand; each tone keeps its colours on any page, so the logo matches its background.

components.name: Icon square
components.use: The square behind a Lucide icon in a card or block. Size is the icon size (16, 24, 32 or 40); the square is the icon plus gap/inline on every side, a solid fill with no border. Pick the size for the card's width (profile icons.in_card), so the icon grows with the card. Swap the icon for one that names the item.

components.name: Card base
components.use: The card surface with an open slot: build any card layout inside it. Default on the page; Secondary then Tertiary when nesting; Featured makes one card stand out from its neighbours (for example a recommended option); Featured, Positive and Negative add a 1px border; Brand and Inverse need on-brand or inverse text inside.

components.name: Card
components.use: Content card: heading (optional eyebrow and sub-text) with a thumbnail beside it, then body. Tone sets surface, border and text colours together.

components.name: Icon Card
components.use: Icon on top, then heading and body. For features, capabilities, benefits.

components.name: Highlight Card
components.use: Icon with a chip on the right, then heading and body. For a feature with a label or status.

components.name: List Item Card
components.use: Compact row: leading icon, title and sub-text, optional trailing icon. For lists of items, steps or links.

components.name: Metric Card
components.use: A single KPI: small label, the value, optional chip for trend or status.

components.name: Banner Card
components.use: A tinted header band with icon and heading, then body. For a section intro or a key message.

components.name: Media Card
components.use: Card with an image, chart or screenshot filling its width. Title on top or media on top; body and tag row are optional.

components.name: FAQ Card
components.use: A title then a stack of Accordion Items separated by dividers. Responsive to the asset: show the answers when the asset needs them (the user supplies them), questions only otherwise.

components.name: Profile Card
components.use: Insight or testimonial: status chip and meta, title, body, tags, a divider, then avatar with name and role.

components.name: Quote card
components.use: A customer or leader quote with the speaker: the quote, a divider, then avatar (a headshot from the asset library, or the client logo), name and role. The quote and the speaker come from the user, word for word; never invent either.

components.name: Badge
components.use: Colour-coded metadata label with a pill radius. Warnings use Negative.

components.name: Button
components.use: Call-to-action with softened square corners (never pill) and an optional trailing arrow. Static: no hover or pressed states.

components.name: Tag
components.use: Statement tag.

components.name: Contact Pill
components.use: Contact or fact pill, for example an email and phone number.
